findings.title: Visibility toggles do not immediately change script-dialog behavior
findings.detail: AreDefaultScriptDialogsEnabled is a document-navigation setting. SetVisible changes it after NavigationStarting, so a visible-loaded page retains default dialogs after hide; a hidden-loaded page cannot regain normal dialogs merely by being shown. This violates silent hidden/modal behavior and visible-page dialog semantics. No ScriptDialogOpening handler exists in the reviewed source.
findings.fix: Disable default dialogs before first navigation and implement visibility-gated ScriptDialogOpening with deferral and asynchronous host UI outside the WebView callback. Hide/destruction must resolve pending dialogs without accepting; preserve visible alert/confirm/prompt behavior. Test hidden transitions without showing desktop UI.

findings.title: Installed editor omits new WebView2 runtime package members
findings.detail: Local install staging copies only FILES (editor executables/UI packages), while additional DLLs are copied only for Actions installs. Thus the normal local installation lacks the new executable-adjacent WebView2Loader.dll, and may remove an existing managed DLL. Neither local nor Actions staging includes WebView2-LICENSE.txt and WebView2-NOTICE.txt. Copying into build/bin alone does not fulfill installed-editor packaging.
findings.fix: Include and verify loader plus both notice files in the effective installation manifest for WebView-enabled builds; cover local and Actions staging. Preserve compatibility for builds without the capability.

findings.title: Native cache restore excludes newly generated WebView2 notices
findings.detail: The native cache output inventory includes executables and generated DLLs only. On cache reuse into an empty bin, the WebView2 loader is restored but its generated LICENSE/NOTICE sidecars are absent; the compilation closure is not executed on a cache hit.
findings.fix: Add required notice sidecars to native output inventory or explicitly verify/copy them after both build and cache reuse. Add a fresh-bin cache restoration check.

checks.name: All six consumed package members and installed SDK bytes
checks.detail: WebView2.h, LICENSE, NOTICE, x86/x64/arm64 loaders match manifest hashes and archive bytes.

checks.detail: Used real pinned WebView2.h; modern interface inheritance matches calls. Existing Windows target links ole32/shell32/user32; SCsub adds uuid for known folder GUID.
